summary.text: Dennis LaBounty is a Democrat and former state representative who served Caledonia-3 District from January 2023 to January 2025 and is a candidate for the same seat (2 seats) in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Before holding office he worked as a machinist, a staff member of the United Steelworkers, and political director of the Vermont AFL-CIO.

paragraphs.text: Dennis LaBounty was born in Newport, Vermont, and earned a degree in applied science from Berlin Technical College.
His career experience includes working as a machinist, a staff member of the United Steelworkers, and political director of the Vermont AFL-CIO.

LaBounty lost general elections for the Vermont House of Representatives in Caledonia-4 District in 2018 and 2020, then won the Caledonia-3 District seat in 2022 and assumed office on January 4, 2023.
He lost re-election in the November 5, 2024 general election, finishing third behind Republicans Martha Feltus and Beth Quimby, and left office on January 8, 2025.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
